About P & S Budget Travel

Your Trusted Sri Lankan Partner for Car with Driver & Custom Tours

At P & S Budget Travel, we make exploring Sri Lanka effortless, safe, and affordable. Whether you need an airport transfer from Bandaranaike International Airport (CMB), a Colombo-to-Kandy/Ella hill country tour, or a multi-day round trip with a dedicated English-speaking chauffeur driver, our well-maintained A/C fleet is ready 24/7.
